mapper.insert: INSERT INTO map_member (map_id, user_id, role, created_at) VALUES (#{mapId}, #{userId}, #{role}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, map_id, user_id, role, created_at FROM map_member WHERE map_id = #{mapId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT mm.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, mm.role, mm.created_at AS joinedAt FROM map_member mm INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = mm.user_id WHERE mm.map_id = #{mapId} ORDER BY FIELD(mm.role, 'OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER'), mm.id
mapper.update: UPDATE map_member SET role = #{role} WHERE map_id = #{mapId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM map_member WHERE map_id = #{mapId} AND user_id = #{userId}
